source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Copy the test record you wish to work on.
3. Take it a copy of a test record and create an advertisement record.
4. Start by making sure the test method (Task Type) in the “results” tab does not say “TBD”
5. Check the “Customer Requirement” value in the results tab against the advertised specification found on the advertisement records “Results” tab.
6. If a test method is listed in the customer requirements tab and there is no method specified in the results value then modify the test record to include the appropriate test method.
7. Make sure the quantities have consistent naming conventions.
8. The advertisement record must have consistent units across products.<eos>
